2607.09204.title: Complexity-Guided Component-wise Initialization for Language Model Pretraining
2607.09204.paper_summary: Pretrained language models often exhibit structured weight spectra, suggesting that training may repeatedly produce similar layerwise and component-wise organization. We ask whether these recurring spectral patterns can be reused as an initialization signal for GPT-2-style language-model pretraining. First, we analyze eleven pretrained GPT-2-style checkpoints that vary in size, language, tokenizer, and training corpus, measuring Frobenius norm and effective-rank entropy across layers and Transformer subcomponents. The checkpoints show shared depth trends, especially increasing scale and stronger spectral concentration in residual-writing matrices. We then construct initialization schemes that imitate the component-wise magnitudes and spectral profiles of pretrained models, and compare them with several weight initialization methods. These initializers visibly change the model's structural spectral patterns, but the evaluation results do not show a corresponding performance advantage. Pretrained-weight reuse remains competitive, while coarse spectral matching alone is not a reliable optimization strategy. Our results suggest that pretrained spectra are useful diagnostics of trained model structure, but that effective reuse likely requires preserving richer information than component-wise scale and singular-value shape.
2607.09204.paper_summary_zh: 預訓練語言模型通常顯示出結構化的權重光譜，這表明訓練可能會重複產生相似的層級和組件組織。我們詢問這些重複的光譜模式是否可以作為GPT-2風格語言模型預訓練的初始化信號。首先，我們分析了十一個不同大小、語言、標記器和訓練語料庫的預訓練GPT-2風格檢查點，測量各層和Transformer子組件的Frobenius範數和有效秩熵。這些檢查點顯示出共享的深度趨勢，特別是在殘差寫入矩陣中，規模增大和光譜集中度增強。我們隨後構建了模仿預訓練模型的組件級幅度和光譜輪廓的初始化方案，並將其與幾種權重初始化方法進行比較。這些初始化器明顯改變了模型的結構光譜模式，但評估結果並未顯示出相應的性能優勢。預訓練權重重用仍然具有競爭力，而僅僅進行粗略的光譜匹配並不是一個可靠的優化策略。我們的結果表明，預訓練光譜是訓練模型結構的有用診斷工具，但有效的重用可能需要保留比組件級規模和奇異值形狀更豐富的信息。
